# Ansatz depth and barren plateaus in variational eigensolvers

A variational quantum eigensolver minimizes the energy $E(\boldsymbol\theta) = \langle\psi(\boldsymbol\theta)|H|\psi(\boldsymbol\theta)\rangle$ over the parameters of a circuit. # Grover search with a noisy oracle

## 1. Introduction

Grover's algorithm finds one marked item among $N$ with $O(\sqrt{N})$ oracle calls. After $k$ iterations the probability of measuring the marked item is $\sin^2\bigl((2k+1)\theta\bigr)$ with $\sin\theta = 1/\sqrt{N}$, which is close to 1 for $k \approx \frac{\pi}{4}\sqrt{N}$.
